content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To put on clothes, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Retrieve a clean undershirt from the dresser (10 seconds)
Step 2. Unbutton the formal dress shirt (30 seconds)
Step 3. Check the trousers for lint (20 seconds)
Step 4. Locate matching dress socks in the drawer (45 seconds)
Step 5. Wake up and get out of bed (1 minute)
Step 6. Straighten the collar of the shirt (15 seconds)
Step 7. Check the final look in the full-length mirror (30 seconds)
Step 8. Tie the laces on the right shoe (40 seconds)
Step 9. Fasten the top button of the shirt (10 seconds)
Step 10. Pull the undershirt over your head and arms (15 seconds)
Step 11. Adjust the wristwatch over the cuff (20 seconds)
Step 12. Step into the left trouser leg (15 seconds)
Step 13. Find the silk necktie in the closet (1 minute)
Step 14. Slide your right arm into the shirt sleeve (10 seconds)
Step 15. Tighten the knot on the necktie (20 seconds)
Step 16. Slide your left arm into the shirt sleeve (10 seconds)
Step 17. Shake out the dress shirt to remove wrinkles (15 seconds)
Step 18. Find the leather belt on the hook (30 seconds)
Step 19. Drape the shirt over your shoulders (10 seconds)
Step 20. Iron the front panels of the shirt (3 minutes)
Step 21. Pull the trousers up to the waist (10 seconds)
Step 22. Thread the belt through the first three loops (25 seconds)
Step 23. Step into the right trouser leg (15 seconds)
Step 24. Tuck the front of the undershirt into the waistband (15 seconds)
Step 25. Steam the blazer to remove creases (5 minutes)
Step 26. Zip up the fly of the trousers (5 seconds)
Step 27. Inspect the undershirt for any stains (20 seconds)
Step 28. Lay the trousers flat on the bed (30 seconds)
Step 29. Pull the right sock over the toes and heel (15 seconds)
Step 30. Smooth the fabric of the undershirt against the skin (10 seconds)
Step 31. Set up the ironing board (2 minutes)

Step 33. Pick up the trousers from the bed (10 seconds)

Step 48. Apply undershirt-friendly body powder (30 seconds)
Step 49. Pull the left sock over the toes and heel (15 seconds)
Step 50. Tuck the shirt tails into the trousers (45 seconds)
Step 51. Remove the trousers from the hanger (15 seconds)
Step 52. Untangle the necktie from other accessories (20 seconds)
Step 53. Pull the shirt collar down (10 seconds)
Step 54. Put on the blazer (20 seconds)
Step 55. Adjust the blazer shoulder pads (15 seconds)
Step 56. Fasten the belt through the remaining loops (20 seconds)
Step 57. Position the shirt for arm entry (15 seconds)
Step 58. Organize the clothing layers on the chair (2 minutes)
Step 59. Put on the right sock (15 seconds)
Step 60. Smooth out the trouser legs (20 seconds)
Step 61. Fasten the blazer buttons (15 seconds)
Step 62. Check the socks for holes (20 seconds)
Step 63. Reach for the dress shirt (10 seconds)
Step 64. Open the dresser drawer (5 seconds)
Step 65. Drape the necktie around your neck (15 seconds)
Step 66. Adjust the blazer lapels (10 seconds)
Step 67. Loop the necktie into a basic knot (45 seconds)
Step 68. Pull the blazer sleeves down (10 seconds)
Step 69. Check the shirt tuck for neatness (20 seconds)
Step 70. Slip the left foot into the dress shoe (10 seconds)
Step 71. Center the blazer on the torso (15 seconds)
Step 72. Put on the left sock (15 seconds)
Step 73. Fill the iron with water (1 minute)
Step 74. Check the shirt alignment with the belt line (20 seconds)
Step 75. Ensure the necktie length is correct (30 seconds)
Step 76. Adjust the shirt collar over the tie (20 seconds)
Step 77. Put on the wristwatch (30 seconds)
Step 78. Fasten the blazer's decorative pins (45 seconds)
Step 79. Place the iron on the heat-safe mat (10 seconds)
Step 80. Unfold the dress shirt carefully (20 seconds)
Step 81. Select the color-coordinated socks (1 minute)
Step 82. Buff the dress shoes with a cloth (2 minutes)
Step 83. Locate the left dress shoe (30 seconds)
Step 84. Tie the laces on the left shoe (40 seconds)
Step 85. Brush any dust off the blazer (1 minute)
Step 86. Take the blazer off the hanger (20 seconds)
Step 87. Apply a small amount of hair gel (1 minute)
Step 88. Find the wristwatch on the nightstand (30 seconds)
Step 89. Ensure both socks are pulled up tight (10 seconds)
Step 90. Sit down on the bench to prepare for shoes (20 seconds)
